1.7.0+261027 (2026-10-27)

OpenTAK ICU settings import works with version 1.6.0 (#64)

The "Import settings" button for OpenTAK ICU now sets the correct stream path. Previously, streams from OpenTAK ICU 1.6.0 failed after importing settings, because the path was sent twice (live/icu/live/icu/<username>). Older OpenTAK ICU versions keep working as before.

Changelog

Fixes

  • fix mypy complaints (4824d3d)
  • explicitly set pg driver (db3c8c5)

Other changes

  • update deps (94eb12c)
